name: Paiute North Tahoe Lateral
researcher_notes: EIA Aug 2026 release, Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 66: Paiute North Tahoe Lateral, Paiute Pipeline, completed Dec 1997, 23 mi, 8 and 16 in, 12.78 MMcf/d added, FERC CP94-29, NV and CA. This is a built 1997 lateral of the operating Paiute system (now Great Basin Gas Transmission, about 898 miles). GEM row P7856 (Great Basin Gas Transmission Company Pipeline System, Main Line, other name Paiute Pipeline Company Pipeline System) already represents that operating system. No separate row for a completed 1997 lateral; the other Paiute historical laterals (Elko, Carson, South Tahoe) are likewise not separate rows. If Baird wants completed laterals tracked separately, this one would qualify on length (37 km) but would be a policy ruling, not a discovery finding. Only one source (EIA, one origin) was checked; no FERC order was opened.
